scenes.name: Heated throw
scenes.note: 10 heat settings, 9 hour timer, machine washable
scenes.vo: A heated throw. Twenty-five forty-nine right now, down from thirty. Ten heat settings, a nine hour timer, and it goes in the washing machine.

scenes.name: vs Silentnight at Argos
scenes.vo: Argos wants sixty quid for the Silentnight one. This is the Amazon best seller at less than half that. It uses about the same power as a light bulb, so an evening on the sofa costs pennies.
